unordered_pair_stabilizer.description: <O^-(6,3),R>; R swaps C_G,C_E and R^2=-I lies in the ordered stabilizer

proof: Restriction to C_G sends the ordered-pair stabilizer in C_Sp(R) to O(B|C_G). Conversely every A in O^-(B|C_G) extends uniquely by u(Rg)=R A g; preserving B and commuting with R implies preserving K.

correction_to_previous_scope.interpretation: Pass9465 proved coordinate-monomial rigidity only; absolute unitary rigidity is false.

boundary: Exact classical-group stabilizer theorem for the finite phase-space package; no claim that every unitary stabilizer element lifts to an integral Niemeier automorphism.
